body_html:
Wanted to get into the functions of innovation systems in terms of learning. Don't like the economic model behind "knowledge brokering" but theory captures a ton of social learning #connectedlearning #cognition #innovation 

For folks with screen readers I describe the infographic here: https://quickthoughts.jgregorymcverry.com/2019/03/03/innovation-systems-and-system-network-agent-theory-and-indiewebhttps://quickthoughts.jgregorymcverry.com/2019/03/03/innovation-systems-and-system-network-agent-theory-and-indieweb

What I added is a symbol for knowledge brokering and how knowledge is created and stored in both the actor and the agent.

Tomorrow I will lush out the idea of agentive apprenticeships.
